quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Fastprint Circuit Tech annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 semiconductor business (annual report): revenue RMB 1,909,605,496.51, up 48.62%, gross margin -9.28% (+23.88 points). IC package substrates (CSP and FCBGA) RMB 1,670,324,734.83, up 49.71%, mainly from CSP substrates with FCBGA still a small share; gross margin -16.06% (+27.80 points), negative because the FCBGA substrate project is not yet in high-volume production and carries heavy labor, depreciation, energy and material costs. Semiconductor test boards RMB 239,280,761.68, up 41.45%, gross margin 38.03%, on stronger semiconductor demand and a higher share of high-layer boards. FCBGA project expenses were RMB 66,209 ten-thousand in 2025, a large drag on net profit; the IC-substrate subsidiary Guangzhou Xingsen posted a net loss of RMB 532,999,812.96.
quarterly_data.figure: IC package substrates RMB 1,670,324,734.83 (+49.71%), gross margin -16.06%; FCBGA project expenses RMB 66,209 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Fastprint Circuit Tech annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (annual report): CSP substrates focus on memory and RF and are expanding into automotive, shifting toward higher-value multilayer and high-difficulty boards. Helped by the memory-chip recovery and higher share at its main memory customers, CSP substrate orders are full and utilization rose quarter by quarter in 2025; a new round of investment to expand capacity has started.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Fastprint Circuit Tech annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (annual report): the FCBGA substrate project is prepared for volume production in technology, capacity and yield; sample orders rose sharply YoY with a rising share of high-layer, large-size products. Its built capacity is ramping, but orders are growing slowly because of long customer certification cycles, so utilization is low and unit labor, depreciation and energy costs are high; in 2026 the company will push domestic customers and pursue overseas customers' factory audits, sampling and volume production. Construction in progress: Guangzhou FCBGA substrate project (budget RMB 5,000,000,000.00) 63.41% complete; Zhuhai FCBGA substrate project (budget RMB 1,000,000,000.00) 91.72%, transferred to fixed assets in 2025 with a construction-in-progress impairment of RMB 5,266,570.01 because volume-production progress and returns fell short of expectations; Zhuhai Xingke IC package substrate project (budget RMB 1,600,000,000.00) 90.03%.
quarterly_data.figure: Guangzhou FCBGA project 63.41% complete; Zhuhai FCBGA impairment RMB 5,266,570.01

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Fastprint Circuit Tech annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 PCB business (annual report): revenue RMB 4,897,079,816.57, up 13.89%, gross margin 25.26% (-1.70 points). Subsidiaries: Yixing Silicon Valley revenue RMB 78,423.51 ten-thousand (+27.24%) with a loss of RMB 9,876.96 ten-thousand, near breakeven in Q4, and the company expects it is likely to reach its profit target in 2026; Fineline revenue RMB 166,616.55 ten-thousand (+15.7%), net profit RMB 15,595.23 ten-thousand (-1.38%, on FX losses and geopolitics-driven shipping costs); Beijing Xingfei revenue RMB 93,676.61 ten-thousand (+8.83%), net profit RMB 12,880.49 ten-thousand (-5.42%). In high-end PCB it is building out Anylayer HDI and substrate-like PCB (SLP) and, beyond high-end smartphones, pushing into high-end optical modules, millimeter-wave communications and AI hardware. The Yixing Silicon Valley phase-2 PCB project, planned to add 8 ten-thousand square meters a month, built about 2 ten-thousand square meters a month and was terminated.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Fastprint Circuit Tech annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): 2025 R&D expense RMB 481,494,925.49, up 8.86%, 6.69% of revenue (7.60% in 2024); 952 R&D staff. Completed in 2025: high-layer FCCSP substrates using low-CTE materials; a high-speed embedded-component substrate process (for 5G and high-end computing such as AI servers / GPUs); high-density ball-mount large-size FCBGA process (development and verification completed); mSAP fine-line volume capability for high-end FC-CSP; blind-cavity capability for high-end IC substrates; qualification of domestic laminates for memory products. Under development: high-precision back-drilling for 112G-and-above products and low-roughness copper foil. Research also covers glass-core package substrates.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Fastprint Circuit Tech annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 outlook (annual report): the company calls AI infrastructure the strongest, fastest and most certain growth engine for PCB, with capacity demand for high-end products rising exponentially. In 2026 it will stay focused on advanced electronic circuits and, applying substrate technology to high-end PCB around FCBGA substrates, UHD, embedded components and high-frequency high-speed PCB, strive for volume-production breakthroughs with some domestic and overseas benchmark customers in the core AI track.
